notices.resetSent: A password reset link was sent.
notices.allRevoked: Every session of the member was ended.
notices.superAdminSaved: The super admin status was saved.

errors.id: That is not a valid record.
errors.passwordMode: Choose what to do with the password.
errors.confirmUsername: Type the member's username exactly as it is shown.
errors.groups: Choose a primary group and valid secondary groups.
errors.promotion: That is not a promotion action.
errors.choice: That is not a valid choice.
errors.points: Enter the points as a whole number.
errors.days: Enter a whole number of days.
errors.daysOrPermanent: Enter the number of days, or tick permanent.
errors.amount: Enter the amount as a whole number, positive to give and negative to take.

header.erased: This account was erased. Its tabs are read-only; what the member wrote stays under the name shown.
header.readOnly: This member ranks at or above you, or is a super admin, so every form is read-only.

list.subtitle: Every account on the site. Open a member to change their details, groups, profile, sanctions and more.
list.heading: Members
list.prefixHelp: A username or an email. With a prefix the list is ordered by username, then by email, not newest first.
list.emptyDescription: No member on this page matches. If a next page is offered, continue: a page can be empty while more rows follow.

identity.heading: Account details
identity.description: Changing these needs your own password. A new password signs the member out everywhere.
identity.newPasswordHelp: Used only when you choose to set a new password.

removeWarning.avatar: The uploaded avatar is deleted. The member can upload another.
removeWarning.cover: The uploaded cover is deleted. The member can upload another.

consent.heading: Cookie choice
consent.none: No cookie choice is saved on this account.
consent.record: Answered policy version {version} on {date, date, medium}.

erase.heading: Delete member
erase.removes: Erasing closes the account for good and removes what identifies the member: their email and password (nobody can sign in or recover the account), their username (it becomes Deleted member plus their number), their about text, title, signature, location, website, birthday, social handles, avatar and cover, and what they wear. Every session and API key ends, pending reset links and queued emails are removed, and their follows end in both directions.
erase.keeps: What they wrote stays as it is under the new name: threads, posts, wall posts and messages. Their credit ledger, warnings and log entries are kept. The account is banned permanently and the ban cannot be lifted afterwards.

groups.heading: Groups
groups.description: The primary group and the groups assigned by hand. Saving needs your own password.
groups.secondaryHelp: Memberships that come from a promotion or a purchase are shown with their origin and are managed there.
groups.refusedTitle: You cannot see this member's groups
groups.refusedDescription: This member ranks at or above you, or is a super admin, so their groups are not shown and cannot be changed.
groups.superAdminDescription: A super admin can act on any member, administrators and themselves included, and no other administrator can act on them. Saving needs your own password. The last super admin cannot be removed.
groups.superAdminHelp: Gives or takes away the super admin status of this member.

promotions.heading: Promotions
promotions.description: Each promotion with the member's state in it. Changing one by hand needs the promotions permission.
promotions.state: {state, select, auto {Automatic} manual {Promoted by hand} exempt {Exempt} other {Never applied}}

profile.heading: Profile
profile.unreadable: The public profile could not be read, so the fields start empty and only what you fill in is sent.
profile.customTitleShown: Shown now: {title}. Type a new one to replace it.
profile.replaceHelp: The stored title cannot be read here. Leave empty to keep it, type to replace it. It can be set whether or not the member may show one.
profile.signatureHelp: The stored source cannot be read here. Leave empty to keep it, type to replace it. It can be set whether or not the member may show one.

appearance.heading: What the member wears
appearance.description: Any active entry can be chosen, whether or not the member holds it. Choices that you leave alone are not changed.
appearance.coverHelp: From the cover gallery. It replaces an uploaded cover while set.

permissions.heading: Permissions of this member
permissions.description: A member's own permission entries are edited with the permission matrix.

sanctions.expiresAfterHelp: Leave empty to use the backend's default.
sanctions.restrictDaysHelp: Leave empty for a restriction without an end.
sanctions.banDescription: A banned member's session stops working on their next request.
sanctions.banDaysHelp: Enter the days, or tick permanent.
sanctions.threadBansHelp: Thread bans are listed per thread. Enter the thread's number to see whether this member is banned in it.
sanctions.notBannedInThread: This member is not banned in that thread.
sanctions.threadUnavailable: That thread's bans cannot be shown to you:

economy.adjustHelp: Positive gives, negative takes. A row is added to the ledger and cannot be removed.
economy.confirm: I confirm this adjustment is written to the ledger.
economy.revokeWarning: Takes back the experience and credits this grant gave. The balance may go below zero.

sessions.heading: Active sessions
sessions.emptyDescription: The member is signed out everywhere.
sessions.revokeOneHelp: Revoking one session can take up to five minutes to take effect on that device. Revoking all sessions is immediate.
sessions.revokeAllWarning: Signs the member out everywhere, at once. Their API keys are not touched.
sessions.refusedTitle: You cannot see this member's sessions
sessions.refusedDescription: This member ranks at or above you, or is a super admin, so their sessions are not shown and cannot be ended.

history.heading: History
history.emptyDescription: No administrative action on this member is recorded.
history.elsewhereHelp: This log holds administrative edits, group changes, warnings, bans, restrictions and session revocations. It does not hold the credit ledger, award grants or the promotion history; they are kept in these places.

bans.subtitle: Every ban, newest first. Lift one that is in force.
bans.heading: Bans
bans.emptyDescription: No ban matches. If a next page is offered, continue.
